texts: On day 246 of Year 1, a thin fog came in off the sea in the evening.
The fog reduced visibility on the Cliff Path.
Coraline Ash kept the lantern of the Harbor Station burning steadily.
The lantern showed mist-light at night.
The nightmoths landed on the lantern.
The nightmoths left silken threads on the lantern.
Coraline Ash collected about thirty-five silken threads from the lantern the next morning.

q1_issues.issue: "left silken threads on the lantern" neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the threads, so the direct object should be Theme, not Patient.
The per-member leave rule repeats the same Patient mis-slot and gives every moth the whole shared group sk_thread_1, claiming each individual moth left all the threads.

q2_gaps: approximate / hedged exact counts ("about thirty-five silken threads") — Cardinality is specified as a native integer, and CardinalityPhrase covers only number-less vague phrases ("several", "dozens"), so a hedged numeral has no licensed form

a maintenance resultative whose result is a progressive activity rather than an adjectival state ("kept the lantern burning steadily") — the State-result shape's flat half then types the object into a verb class, (Member sk_lantern_1 burn), and whether the complement takes Ongoing beside Still is unaddressed
review.notes: (Cardinality sk_thread_2 (ParticleFromNormal 35 3.5)) is a reasonable extrapolation of the Measures approximation rule but puts a distribution in a slot the instruction set fixes as a native integer. Minor: the witness sk_mistlight_1 departs from the sk_<class>_<n> convention for class mist_light.

issues.reason: Thematic roles reserves Patient for an object the action creates, destroys, consumes or physically changes and gives Theme to one merely moved or deposited ("displacement stays displacement whatever is moved", and unclear cases "default to Theme"), so (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1) asserts a change to the threads that "left silken threads on the lantern" does not state.

Both halves stand: the rule repeats the same Patient mis-slot, and handing every member the shared constant sk_thread_1 derives that each individual moth left the entire collection, whereas the universal-over-indefinite default ("genuine ambiguity → first quantifier takes wide scope", the "every student read three books" per-binding Skolem-group pattern) makes the threads a dependent (sk_thread $x).

gaps_confirmed: Hedged / approximate exact counts ("about thirty-five silken threads"): Cardinality is fixed to a native integer, CardinalityPhrase covers only number-less vague phrases, and the ParticleFromNormal approximation is defined only for the Measure family and clock times — so an approximated numeral count has no licensed carrier.

Maintenance resultative whose result is a progressive activity rather than an adjectival state ("kept the lantern burning steadily"): the State-result shape's mandatory flat half yields the ill-typed (Member sk_lantern_1 burn), typing an entity into an event class, and whether Ongoing joins Still on the state witness is unspecified.
new_gaps: Fictional-calendar day-of-year ordinal ("day 246 of Year 1"): (Day <n>) is specified as a calendar day-of-month term with no way to mark a day-of-year index, and the "the next morning" +1 increment inherits that ambiguity when it emits (Day 247) — a licensed form would need a granularity term carrying "nth day of the year".
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0's compliant form is (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1) in place of the Patient atom, the threads being deposited rather than altered. Issue 1's compliant form is the same per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_nightmoth_1) with Theme and a per-binding Skolem group — (Theme (sk_leave $x) (sk_thread $x)) (GroupOf (sk_thread $x) silken_thread) — so each moth leaves its own threads instead of the whole shared collection; both fixes are licensed by existing machinery.
adjudication.notes: Beyond the confirmed issues, two gap-territory improvisations cross the calibration line on their own: (Cardinality sk_thread_2 (ParticleFromNormal 35 3.5)) puts a distribution in a slot the instruction set fixes as a native integer, and the maintenance resultative's flat half (Member sk_lantern_1 burn) types an entity into an event class — neither has a licensed compliant form, which is what the two confirmed gaps record. The "next morning" arithmetic (Day 247 + Year 1 + morning + Before), the phrasal come_in kept whole with a Patient fog, and the Theme on keep are all correct.
